A threshold grid: 7 litres rounds the 7.5 threshold the wrong way, 9 leaves out the hand set-up time, 6 leaves out set-up on both sides, and the 365-day slip that still gives 8 is named in sourceHas.
D keeps (1 − rate) instead of the commission, A divides by the rates and multiplies by hours, B adds instead of multiplying and swaps the rates; each is one slip or a pair of slips.

52% is the complement of the true 48%, D is a near-miss where the two per-head figures are actually equal at $0.75m, and B, about profit the exhibit does not show, is the one statement without data that sourceHas allows.

4% stops at the loss as a share of sales, 24% takes the increase over the new sales instead of the old, and 17% is the one numeric filler below the answer that sourceHas allows.
$40 is the basic-cover premium, $109 adds the $29 legal cover, and $138 continues the $29 spacing as the one numeric filler that sourceHas allows.
